heard: Wembun Yama spent four days with a pro rugby team and only now can you see it. Provence Rugby, a French second division club, posted the footage this weekend. Wembie in cleats next to Harrison Barnes. He admits he has never tackled in his life. They hand him a tackle shield, then the forwards lift him in a line out. The coach says a man that size makes for some very strange situations. Last summer, it was Kung Fu at Shaolin Temple. So why Rugby? The training itself was really hard. I think it was really good for the vestibular system, new movement patterns.
